label: Cloud backup
intent: Files are backed up to the cloud. Light: the backup arrow inside the cloud runs one full turn clockwise and comes to rest on its mark, and the cloud takes the copy, bumping up and settling. Strong: the arrow winds back first, then runs a fast turn that overshoots its mark and settles back, and the cloud bumps higher and settles in two beats.

cloud.//: cloud-upload's cloud, open at the bottom where the loop sits
